style.styleTitle: Homcom 5Ft Prelit Fibre Optic Artificial Christmas Tree With Multicolour Lights Green
style.toneOfVoice: <p>This Christmas tree with lights and a glowing star from HOMCOM is a great addition to your festive celebrations and a great focal point in your room. The built-in fibre optic light stays lit when turned on and will create a soft glow around the tree using three colours combination. Made from PVC with a fresh cut look, and with a metal stand to keep your tree firmly secured while in use. It is also made to last for years with easy folding and disassembly ready for the next year.</p><ul><li>Pine styled tree stands up tall;</li><li>Made of dense PVC needles with branches with natural look to last all season;</li><li>Pre-lit colourful optical fibre lights expanding the whole tree;</li><li>Includes a star topper attached to the tree adding a festival glow to your home;</li><li>Sturdy foldable metal base provides stability to keep your tree standing firm;</li><li>Easy to assembly and disassemble for storage;</li><li>Perfect for indoor decoration at Christmas, creating festive mood;</li><li>RECOMMENDED SETUP: For the fullest results, work from bottom to top spreading every branch in a spiral motion;</li><li>Item Name: Christmas Tree;</li><li>Brand Name: HOMCOM;</li><li>Material: PVC, Metal Stand;</li><li>Colour: Green;</li><li>5FT: F73x150H (cm);</li><li>Branch Tip: 4FT: 130. 5FT: 180;</li><li>Transformer Voltage: 100-240V 50/60Hz;</li><li>Cord Length: 1.8m;</li><li>Power: 3.6W;</li><li>Flat Pack: YES;</li><li>Certification: CE, ROHS;</li><li>Assembly Required: YES;</li></ul>
